title: Obras — Vol. 2: 1907-1913
author: Iósif Stalin
desc: Los años de reacción y reorganización clandestina: Bakú, la Duma, la masacre de la Lena, Pravda y El marxismo y la cuestión nacional. Con crónica biográfica 1907-1917.
tesis: Segundo volumen de las Obras: los escritos de Stalin de 1907 a 1913, los años más duros de la clandestinidad — la reacción stolypiniana, el trabajo en Bakú entre arrestos y escapes, la polémica contra los liquidacionistas, la fundación de Pravda y la masacre de la Lena que reactivó al movimiento obrero. Culmina con El marxismo y la cuestión nacional (1913), escrito a instancias de Lenin: su texto teórico más influyente, que define la nación como comunidad histórica constituida.
ideas: La derrota de 1905 no disolvió al partido: la prensa legal e ilegal (Bakinsky Proletary, Gudok, Pravda) mantuvo la organización viva bajo la reacción.
El marxismo y la cuestión nacional (1913) define la nación como comunidad histórica de lengua, territorio, vida económica y cultura — la teoría que luego ordenó la política nacional soviética.
La masacre de la Lena (1912) reactivó la huelga de masas en todo el imperio: del desplome de 1907 a la recuperación abierta de 1912.
contexto: Edición inglesa de Foreign Languages Publishing House, Moscú 1953 (edición rusa de las Сочинения del Instituto Marx-Engels-Lenin). Cubre de 1907 a 1913, del Congreso de Londres a la víspera de la guerra mundial. Al final incluye la crónica biográfica 1907-marzo 1917: la secuencia de arrestos, exilios en Solvychegodsk y Turujansk, y escapes.

conexiones.razon: Los tres volúmenes cubren en continuidad de 1901 a octubre de 1917.
Problemas Económicos (1952) es el Stalin tardío; aquí está el Stalin clandestino, décadas antes.

tl: Quinto Congreso (Londres) del POSDR consolida bolcheviques

The London Congress is over... the congress did not result in a split, but in the further consolidation of the Party, in the further unification of the advanced workers of all Russia in one indivisible party.
Stalin redige el Mandato a los diputados de la Tercera Duma

The Social-Democratic deputies in the State Duma must form a separate group which, as a Party organisation, must be most closely connected with the Party, and must submit to its guidance and to the directives of the Central Committee of the Party.
Arresto en Bakú y deportación a Vólogda
J. V. Stalin, under the alias Gaioz Nizharadze, is arrested and confined in the Bailov prison in Baku.
La crisis del Partido y la tarea de un órgano todo ruso
It is sufficient to point to St. Petersburg, where in 1907 we had about 8,000 members and where we can now scarcely muster 300 to 400, to appreciate at once the full gravity of the crisis.
Stalin escapa del destierro de Solvychegodsk
June 24 J. V. Stalin escapes from Solvychegodsk. Beginning of July While on his way J. V. Stalin stays several days in St. Petersburg.
Carta al CC desde el destierro de Solvychegodsk
The plan for a bloc reveals the hand of Lenin—he is a shrewd fellow, and knows a thing or two. But this does not mean that any kind of bloc is good. A Trotsky bloc... would be rank unprincipledness.
Matanza del Lena reaviva la lucha política obrera

In St. Petersburg and Moscow, in Riga and Kiev, in Saratov and Yekaterinoslav, in Odessa and Kharkov, in Baku and Nikolayev—everywhere, in all parts of Russia, the workers are rising in vindication of their comrades who were murdered on the Lena.
Llamado de Stalin al Primero de Mayo en Rusia

And confident of victory, calm and strong, they are marching proudly along the road to the promised land, towards glorious socialism, step by step carrying out Karl Marx's great call: 'Workers of all countries, unite!'
Stalin viaja clandestino a Cracovia para ver a Lenin
Before November 10 J. V. Stalin secretly arrives in Cracow to visit V. I. Lenin.
Conferencia de Praga elige a Stalin al Comité Central
At the Sixth ("Prague") General Party Conference, J. V. Stalin is in his absence elected a member of the Central Committee of the Bolshevik Party.
Fuga de Stalin de Vólogda y campaña por el partido

it is necessary to have... a strong and flexible proletarian party that will be able to unite the separate efforts of the local organisations in one common effort and thereby direct the mass revolutionary movement against the main fortifications of the enemy.
Aparece el primer número de Pravda en San Petersburgo
Working-class writers do not drop ready-made from the skies; they can be trained only gradually, in the course of literary activity.
Stalin recuerda el Domingo Sangriento del 9 de enero
Russia is still being strangled by the Romanov monarchy, which is preparing this year to celebrate the 300th anniversary of its bloody rule over our country.
Stalin escribe El marxismo y la cuestión nacional en Viena
Thus, a nation is not a racial or tribal, but a historically constituted community of people.
Llamado al aniversario de la matanza del Lena
And lastly, on January 9, 1913, as many as 200,000 Russian workers went on strike in honour of the memory of the fallen fighters, calling on all democratic Russia to launch a fresh struggle.
Detención de Stalin en San Petersburgo y exilio en Turujansk
February 23 J. V. Stalin is arrested in the hall of the Kalashnikov Exchange at a concert arranged by the St. Petersburg Bolshevik organisation and is taken to prison.
